# IArmZapper
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/origin/IArmZapper.sol)

**Title:**
IArmZapper

Interface for the zapper that deposits native ETH into the Lido ARM


## Functions
### deposit

Deposit ETH to LidoARM and receive shares


```solidity
function deposit() external payable returns (uint256 shares);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The amount of ARM LP shares sent to the depositor|
